menu_options.cloud: Sign in with Bambu account (easiest — finds everything)

cloud.title: Sign in to Bambu Lab
cloud.description: Your account hands over the printer list, each printer's access code, and enables hybrid/cloud connectivity. Leave the password empty to sign in with an emailed code instead.

cloud_code.title: Check your email
cloud_code.description: Bambu sent a verification code to {email}.

cloud_tfa.title: Two-factor code
cloud_tfa.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

cloud_pick.title: Pick your printer
cloud_pick.description: If the printer is on this network it will be linked in hybrid mode automatically (local control + cloud fallback).

reauth_cloud.title: Bambu sign-in expired
reauth_cloud.description: Cloud tokens expire every few months. A fresh code was emailed to {email}.

scan.title: Printers found
scan.description: Pick your printer. It must be on the same network as Home Assistant.

code.title: Connect to {name}
code.description:
Found **{name}** at `{host}` (serial `{serial}`).

Enter the **access code** from the printer's screen: Settings → Network. For full control (and on current firmware, any control at all) also enable **LAN Only Mode** and **Developer Mode** there. Note: the access code changes when you toggle those modes — read it after enabling them.

manual.title: Printer details
manual.description: From the printer's screen (Settings → Network): IP address, serial number, and access code. Enable LAN Only Mode + Developer Mode for control.

reauth_confirm.title: Access code changed
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the stored access code (it changes when LAN/Developer mode is toggled). Enter the current code from the printer's screen.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: Change the printer's address or access code. Tip: give the printer a DHCP reservation in your router.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer. Check the IP and that it is powered on.
error.invalid_auth: The printer rejected that access code.
error.no_report: Connected, but got no status. Double-check the serial number.
error.none_found: No printers announced themselves. Enter the details manually.
error.cloud_login: Bambu sign-in failed — check the email and password.
error.cloud_code: That code was rejected — request a new one and try again.

abort.already_configured: That printer is already set up (its address was updated).
abort.no_cloud_devices: No new printers on that Bambu account (already added, or none bound).

menu_options.environment: Room sensor, heater and power plug

connection.title: How Home Assistant reaches the printer
connection.description: LAN = fully local. Hybrid = local first, Bambu cloud as fallback (keeps working if the IP changes). Cloud = no LAN needed, but no camera/FTPS features. Tick 'Link Bambu account' to enable hybrid/cloud.

cloud_link.title: Link Bambu account
cloud_link.description: Submit once with just the email to receive a code, then again with the code filled in.

environment.title: Where the printer lives
environment.description: All optional. A room temperature sensor unlocks cold-start protection and smarter heat soaks; a humidity sensor adds dew point and condensation warnings; a smart plug powering a space heater lets the soak pre-warm the room; a power-monitoring plug on the printer tracks energy per print.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Pick notify services (your phones) and which events they get. Notifications include snapshots and action buttons.

costs.title: Costs
costs.description: Per-type overrides example: PLA=18, PETG=22, ABS=20

soak.title: Heat soak tuning
soak.description: The soak holds the chamber inside the band for the preset time, plus extra minutes the colder the room is below the reference.

data.hms_lookup: Fetch human-readable HMS error texts from Bambu (one small download)

controls_rejected.title: {name}: printer refused a command
controls_rejected.description: The printer refused `{command}` ({reason}). On current Bambu firmware, control commands require **LAN Only Mode + Developer Mode** (printer screen → Settings → Network). Monitoring keeps working either way. After toggling those modes the access code changes — re-enter it when Home Assistant asks.

send_gcode.name: Send G-code
send_gcode.description: Send one or more G-code lines to the printer.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Publish a raw JSON payload to the printer's MQTT request topic.

jog.name: Jog axis
jog.description: Move an axis by a relative distance (idle only).

load_filament.name: Load filament
load_filament.description: Load a tray (global index; 254 = external spool).

set_filament.name: Set tray filament
set_filament.description: Write type/colour/temps to an AMS tray.

print_file.name: Print file
print_file.description: Start printing a .3mf already on the printer.

skip_objects.name: Skip objects
skip_objects.description: Exclude objects from the running print.

start_heat_soak.name: Start heat soak
start_heat_soak.description: Heat chamber and bed, hold, then notify or auto-start.

autostart.name: Auto-start
autostart.description: Start the selected SD file when soaked.

cancel_heat_soak.name: Cancel heat soak
cancel_heat_soak.description: Stop the soak and turn heaters off.

render_timelapse.name: Render timelapse
render_timelapse.description: Render a kept frame set to MP4.

make_gif.name: Make GIF
make_gif.description: Convert a clip to a shareable GIF.

delete_timelapse.name: Delete timelapse
delete_timelapse.description: Delete a clip from the library.

rename_timelapse.name: Rename timelapse
rename_timelapse.description: Rename a clip in the library.

delete_sd_file.name: Delete printer file
delete_sd_file.description: Delete a file from the printer's storage.

pull_printer_timelapses.name: Pull printer timelapses
pull_printer_timelapses.description: Copy the printer's own SD-card timelapses into the library.

upload_file.name: Upload file
upload_file.description: Upload a .3mf from the HA config folder to the printer, optionally start it.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Request a full status push and re-list printer storage.

queue_add.name: Queue a print
queue_add.description: Append a printer-storage file to the print queue.

queue_remove.name: Remove from queue
queue_remove.description: Remove one queued job by position (0 = next).

queue_start_next.name: Start next queued print
queue_start_next.description: Start the first job in the queue (printer must be idle, bed clear).

maintenance_done.name: Mark maintenance done
maintenance_done.description: Reset a maintenance item's clock (e.g. lube_rails, nozzle_wear).

item.name: Item
item.description: Item key from the maintenance sensor.

filament_info.name: Filament info
filament_info.description: Look up a filament in the built-in materials database; optionally check bonding against another material.

pair_with.name: Pair with
pair_with.description: Second material for a bonding verdict.
